preflight_v10_diagnostic.role: non-inferential implementation, evidence and safety preflight
preflight_v10_diagnostic.finding: The manager supplied accurate fresh metric corrections after 2.48-s and 4.96-s camera intervals, but the planner discarded both solely because the interval between correction anchors exceeded state_max_predict_dt_s=1.5 s. Dense timestamped encoder odometry covered each complete interval. The unattended belief then drifted laterally until the rectangular-footprint driveable-area gate correctly safe-stopped the robot. A long camera interval was therefore incorrectly treated as a missing-motion interval.
preflight_v10_diagnostic.evidence_integrity_finding: The run also failed identity verification because use_diagnostic_odom_localization was configured and passed to the logger but absent from run_manifest.json. In addition, two different planner predictions could share a Pose timestamp without an anchor revision, so the schema-8 Pose stream could not support a unique own-time belief series.

supported_motion_replay_amendment.rule: state_max_predict_dt_s=1.5 s remains the maximum permitted gap between timestamped motion inputs. A longer interval between camera corrections may be replayed only when plan_replay proves complete odometry support over the entire interval and the prior support history is also valid. The fresh metric correction then faces the unchanged covariance, jump and NIS gates. Any unsupported interval is dropped and retained as replay_gap_too_large.
supported_motion_replay_amendment.rationale: Camera availability and motion observability are different processes. Refusing a fresh camera measurement merely because no camera measurement arrived recently discards exactly the evidence needed after a visibility outage. Conditioning on complete odometry support fixes the model mismatch without using ground truth, widening NIS, enabling re-anchoring or weakening geometry safety.

evidence_repairs.manifest_identity: Declare, read and write use_diagnostic_odom_localization in every run manifest.
evidence_repairs.belief_identity: Logging schema 9 adds belief_predictions.jsonl, retaining the full planner-published prediction with state timestamp, anchor epoch/revision, covariance, validity and motion support. Analysis retains the highest anchor revision at each state timestamp.

preflight_release_gate.reference_alignment: own-time bounded interpolation of logged ground truth with max_reference_gap_s=0.15; highest explicit anchor revision per belief state timestamp
required: bootstrap evidence records one admitted camera plus the declared start prior
goal reached without collision, timeout, stuck stop or integrity failure
ground-truth final goal distance is at most 0.35 m
run manifest records local_use_obs_risk, use_diagnostic_odom_localization, bootstrap policy, command noise and encoder noise
logging schema 9 belief ledger contains no invalid envelopes
terminal stop and producer quiescence are verified
preflight_release_gate.failure_policy: Do not launch the final campaign unless every gate passes. Preserve a failed preflight and create a new immutable amendment before another run. Do not change the detector, Stage-06 gate, Stage-07/08 model, selected route, controller, speed, fusion rule or noise from a preflight outcome.

prohibitions: Do not use V8, V9, V10 or V11 preflight observations as navigation comparison evidence.
Do not lower the image-border, hull, confidence or Stage-08 route-support gates.
Do not raise the NIS threshold to force rejected measurements through.
Do not enable single-fused-event re-anchoring in this campaign.
Do not use ground truth in detection, fusion, estimation, planning or control.
Do not edit the V8/V11 configs after this protocol is frozen.
